To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the safety and running performance suitable for advanced next-generation EVs can be obtained from a FRID EV that can independently control the driving, braking, and steering forces of the front wheels and independently control the driving force of the rear wheels.

we have succeeded in clarifying the safety and running performance characteristics of next-generation EVs, which are expected to be developed as the next-generation vehicles, and that these performance characteristics have been confirmed by undertaking tests under severe running conditions.

the running performance of FRIDs EVs, which cannot be obtained from EVs that have been developed to date, was obtained from a propulsion power generating system that can mutually and independently control the driving forces of the front/rear wheels.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a propulsion power generating system that can control the driving and brake forces of the front wheel independently and that of the rear wheels independently, and with the development of energy saving control and braking and corner driving control functions.
the development of propulsion power generating systems for next-generation EVs that can achieve energy saving control and high running safety performance.

the development of a propulsion power generating system for front and rear wheel independently drivable electric vehicles (FRIDs) that can mutually or individually control the front and rear drive and braking forces.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the running performance of FRIDs is superior to the conventional EVs.
FRID EVs with outstanding running performance have been developed for use as next-generation EVs.
the running performance of front/rear wheel independent drive type EVs is superior to that of EVs equipped with a conventional propulsion power generating system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the outstanding performance of the prototype FRID EVs was verified, and it was clarified that the running performance of FRIDs is superior to that of conventional EVs.

the running performance of FRIDs, which could not previously be obtained from the power generating systems of EVs, is produced from power generating systems that are capable of mutually and independently controlling the driving and braking force of the front and the rear wheels.

the outstanding running performance of FRIDs EVs is clarified by using the propulsion power generating system that can independently control the driving force and braking force of the front and the rear wheel.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the FRID EV is an advanced, next-generation EV with outstanding running performance, and is expected to contribute to the realization of a sustainable society.

the energy saving control performance is improved by 30% and braking and cornerning performance is improved by approximately 20%, as compared with a vehicle using the conventional propulsion power generating systems.

the energy saving control performance of EVs is improved and the braking and cornering performances are improved by optimizing the driving forces of the front wheels and the driving and braking force of the rear wheels, and by optimizing the relationship among the longitudinal and lateral tire forces.
